title: Autoformer: Autoformer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTm1, Traffic at horizon 336
abstract: We study long-horizon multivariate forecasting using Autoformer, a decomposition transformer with auto-correlation. On ETTh1, ETTm1, Traffic, at horizon 336, Autoformer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTm1, Traffic at horizon 336. Reported MSE reduction of 12% versus the strongest prior transformer on ETTh1 at horizon 336. We discuss two limitations: Hyperparameters are tuned per-dataset, which advantages larger models that can absorb the added capacity. Attention weights are not analysed, leaving the interpretability claims unverified. Future work should address reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric. and reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
